## Install

```sh
uv tool install omarchy-dms     # or: pipx install omarchy-dms
```

Already installed? `uv tool upgrade omarchy-dms` (or `pipx upgrade omarchy-dms`).
With Nix: `nix run github:Villoh/omarchy-dms/{tag}`.

You need DMS with the dmsProfiles plugin; see the
[documentation](https://github.com/Villoh/omarchy-dms/tree/{tag}/docs).
Package on PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/omarchy-dms/{version}/
